title: Following the Whispers of Values: Unraveling Neural Mechanisms Behind Value-Oriented Behaviors in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM alignment with non-Western cultural norms by measuring their support rate for value-aligned behaviors using C-Voice, a bilingual benchmark of moral dilemmas based on 12 dimensions of Chinese Social Values. The paper also measures changes in this alignment after deactivating identified value-specific neurons.

Comparing the models' value preferences and neuron activation overlap patterns when the exact same moral dilemmas are presented in English versus Chinese, demonstrating how input language impacts the manifestation of social values.
